newsitem.title: USA: BEI adopts rights plan with 15 pct trigger.
newsitem.headline: BEI adopts rights plan with 15 pct trigger.

text.p: BEI Electronics Inc said Wednesday it adopted a shareholders rights plan with a 15 percent trigger.
The company said all shareholders of recond as of July 18 will receive rights to buy shares of a new series of preferred stock.
The rights will be distributed as a non-taxable dividend and will expire in ten years from the record date.
They rights will be exercisable only if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of its common stock or announces a tender offer for 15 percent or more of its common stock.
If a person acquires 15 percent or more of the company's common stock, all rightsholders except the buyer will be entitled to acquire stock at a discount.
The company said the rights plan is meant to guard against abusive takeover tactics. It is not a reaction to an unsolicited offer.
